thread:
violet: Starting v2.24 deploy. Feature-flag plan for `rec-autopromo` = start OFF -> 3% canary -> progressive slowstart to 30% with 3% steps every 6m, final 100% in overnight quiet window if green. Change window 23:45-01:00 UTC. Pin model for the canary. I'll paste runbook and quick abort steps.

 deploy-bot: [deploy] v2.24 kickoff on prod-cluster-7. Canary cohort = cohort-autopromo-canary.

 omar: Pinning to avoid model drift: `/infra pin-model --service rec-autopromo --version rwd-model-2026-05-01 --until 30pct` 

 violet: starting 3% canary: `/ff set rec-autopromo --target 3 --reason "v2.24 canary initial"`

 deploy-bot: Flag set -> 3% success. Snapshot: error-rate delta +0.04%, p95 +11ms, kv cache hit 87%. Auto-circuit: disable if error_delta > 1.0% OR p95 +200ms OR gpu_mem > 85%.

 kevin: Ops thresholds we agreed in runbook: sustained error_delta >=0.9% for 5m OR p99 +250ms -> immediate drain to 0% and rollback. Also watch embedding queue depth and model allocation failures.

 pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident created and routed to ops-oncall. Escalation schedule set.

 ops-oncall: I'm watching dashboards. Muting low priority alerts, will surface only sev >= high. Keys: p50/p95/p99, error-rate per route, embedding throughput, model GPU mem.

 deploy-bot: progressing slowstart: 6% -> 9% -> 12% (no guards tripped). Telemetry: error +0.1%, p95 +16ms, mem 64%.

 violet: Quick QA note: small inconsistency in ranking for internal cohort B, logged as INC-4302. Not blocking public ramp. Leaving debug logs on for internal cohort for 10m: `/infra set-log-level --service rec-autopromo --cohort internal --level debug --duration 600s`

 kevin: If we need to abort fast, oncall should run this snippet (curl):
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" "https://api.redwood/flags/rec-autopromo?action=set&target=0&force=true"
Also rollback command: `/infra rollback-release --id v2.24 --drain 30s` and then `/infra unpin-model --service rec-autopromo` after rollback completes.

 deploy-bot: Reached 30% -> smoke tests running for 10m.

 ops-oncall: smoke complete. No SLO breaches. Recommend 90m soak before 100% flip, given overnight traffic patterns.

 violet: Agreed. I'll update the change-window note and post a final go/no-go thread before the 100% flip. If we hit any circuit condition we follow rollback steps above and file an incident with `/logs ff rec-autopromo --last 30m`. Thanks team.
